text: @SpotifyCares my downloaded songs won't play offline on the train this morning, super annoying
@50001 oof! try toggling offline mode off and on in Settings, then re-download the playlist while on wifi. that clears most sync issues 🎧
@SpotifyCares that fixed it, thank you!
@SpotifyCares I was charged twice for Premium this month, need one of those refunded
@50002 that's not right — we don't have access to card details here, can you DM us the email on the account so we can check the charges?
@SpotifyCares sent you a DM
@SpotifyCares can't log in, it keeps saying my password is wrong and the reset email never arrives
@50003 check your spam folder for the reset mail, and make sure you're resetting from spotify.com/password. if you signed up with Facebook, use 'Log in with Facebook' instead
@SpotifyCares still nothing, this is useless
@SpotifyCares the new Discover Weekly is all songs I already know, bring back the old algorithm please
@50004 thanks for the feedback! the more you skip/save, the more it adapts. we'll pass the note about repeats to the team 🙌
@SpotifyCares Spotify Connect won't find my Sonos speakers since the last update
@50005 make sure the phone and speakers are on the same wifi band, then fully close the app and reopen. if Sonos still doesn't show, remove and re-add the Spotify service in the Sonos app
@SpotifyCares re-adding the service worked, cheers
@SpotifyCares why is half of Taylor Swift's catalogue greyed out in my library??
@50006 licensing for some albums changes by region and over time, which greys tracks out. they usually come back — nothing wrong on your end
@SpotifyCares want to cancel my Premium before the next billing date, how do I do that
@50007 you can cancel anytime at spotify.com/account/subscription — you keep Premium until the end of the current cycle, then it drops to free
@SpotifyCares got it, thanks
@SpotifyCares family plan says my address doesn't match the plan manager's but we live together
@50008 the address just needs to match what the plan manager set, exactly. have them check the spelling/format in Account, then you can re-confirm from the email prompt
@SpotifyCares app crashes every time I open the Search tab on my iPhone
@50009 try deleting and reinstalling the app — that rebuilds the local cache that's crashing Search. your playlists are safe on your account
@SpotifyCares reinstalching fixed it thanks so much
@SpotifyCares someone is playing music on my account from another country, I think I've been hacked
@50010 let's secure it now. go to spotify.com/account and 'Sign out everywhere', then change your password. DM us if anything looks off after that
@SpotifyCares podcast episodes disappear from my downloads after a day
@50011 there's a setting under Your Library > Downloads that removes episodes you've finished. turn off 'Remove played downloads' to keep them
@SpotifyCares perfect, that was it
@SpotifyCares I'm being charged the full price but I signed up for the student discount
@50012 student pricing has to be reverified each year through SheerID. DM us the account email and we'll check where the verification stands
@SpotifyCares shuffle play isn't random, it plays the same 10 songs
@50013 shuffle weights tracks you play and skip. playing an album or a bigger playlist end to end for a bit resets the weighting
@SpotifyCares Android Auto shows 'Spotify not responding' since I updated my phone
@50014 clear the cache for both Spotify and Android Auto in phone Settings > Apps, then reconnect the cable. that clears the handshake error
@SpotifyCares working now, thank you!
@SpotifyCares wrapped is wrong, it says my top artist is someone I never listen to
@50015 Wrapped counts a set window and includes background/autoplay. if a family member shares the account that can skew it too
@SpotifyCares I cancelled last month and you charged me again today, I want that money back
@50016 that shouldn't happen if the cancel went through. DM us the account email and the date you cancelled and we'll sort the refund
@SpotifyCares DM sent
@SpotifyCares songs skip after 10 seconds on my Premium account, wifi is fine
@50017 log out, restart the phone, log back in. if it's only certain songs they may be corrupted downloads — delete and re-download them
@SpotifyCares logging out and back in did it, thanks
@SpotifyCares can I move my playlists from one account to another? I made a new email
@50018 there's no built-in transfer, but you can follow your own playlists from the new account, or use a third-party importer. your username can't be changed though
@SpotifyCares the Premium price went up and nobody told me, this is a joke
@50019 sorry for the surprise — price changes are emailed in advance to the account address. DM us the email and we'll confirm what changed and your options
@SpotifyCares Alexa says 'account not linked' even though I just linked it in the app
@50020 unlink Spotify in the Alexa app, then relink and set it as the default music service. the first link often doesn't stick
@SpotifyCares that worked, appreciate it
@SpotifyCares why can't I download more than 10000 songs offline, I have space
@50021 10,000 tracks per device across up to 5 devices is the current offline limit. it's a licensing cap, not a storage one
@SpotifyCares my kid is on our family plan but keeps getting logged out
@50022 that usually means the same login is being used on two phones. each family member needs their own Spotify login under the plan
@SpotifyCares ah that makes sense, thanks
@SpotifyCares no sound from Spotify on my PS4 but YouTube works fine
@50023 close the app fully on the PS4 (not just back to the dashboard) and reopen. if still silent, check the PS4 audio output is set to the same device
@SpotifyCares sorted, thanks
@SpotifyCares I want a refund AND I'm cancelling, your service has been broken for a week and support is ignoring me
@50024 that's a bad experience and we want to make it right. DM us the account email and a summary of the week's issues and we'll review a refund
@SpotifyCares lyrics feature vanished from all my songs today
@50025 lyrics rolled back in a few regions while the provider changes. it should return automatically — nothing to fix on your side
@SpotifyCares how do I stop Spotify opening on startup on my laptop
@50026 in the desktop app go Settings > Show Advanced Settings > Startup and window behaviour, and set it to 'Don't open automatically'
@SpotifyCares gift card code says 'already redeemed' but I just bought it
@50027 keep the receipt and the card — DM us photos of both and the code, and we'll get it applied or replaced
